description.math_summary: Newton is the live engine selector for classical Newton basin fractal.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: z_{n+1}=z_n-P(z_n)/P'(z_n), with P from poly_coeffs (default z^3-1).
description.state_order: first-order in z_n.
description.termination_or_classification: The orbit converges when polynomial residual is below epsilon; it otherwise stops on a degenerate derivative, nonfinite state, or the iteration limit.
description.interpretation_notes: Changing the polynomial or root layout can move, merge, or split basin features, so feature tracking requires mathematical continuation and exact viewport geometry.

description.math_summary: Nova is the live engine selector for Nova root-finding escape-time hybrid.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: z_{n+1}=z_n-alpha*P(z_n)/P'(z_n)+c, with z_0=0 and c=pixel coordinate.
description.state_order: first-order in z_n with fixed additive c.
description.termination_or_classification: The orbit converges when polynomial residual is below epsilon and is classified as escaped for invalid alpha, squared magnitude above 4, or nonfinite state; it otherwise reaches the iteration limit.
description.interpretation_notes: At high zoom, a small dynamics-parameter change can move or reorganize visible structures substantially; compare against the exact viewport facts rather than inferring visual scale from numeric magnitude.

description.math_summary: ExplainO is the live engine selector for seeded damped Newton on generated degree-4 polynomial.

description.termination_or_classification: The orbit converges when polynomial residual is below epsilon; it otherwise stops on a degenerate derivative, nonfinite state, or the iteration limit.

description.math_summary: ExplainO All is the canonical public ExplainO selector: neutral registry axes resolve to the baseline ExplainO runtime, while any active registered axis keeps the canonical composed branch.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The composed branch evaluates a degree-four real-coefficient polynomial and its derivative, forms a Newton step, and can combine alternating coefficient sets, vortex rotation, a perpendicular ripple kick, tension and balance-field biases, adaptive damping, and an optional Phoenix memory term.
description.state_order: With a neutral Phoenix coefficient the update depends on the current complex state; with a nonzero Phoenix coefficient it also uses the previous state and is second-order in the stored orbit state.
description.termination_or_classification: The branch tests polynomial residual against epsilon, rescales states outside radius four, resets and stops on nonfinite state, and otherwise classifies an unconverged result at the best recorded iteration by snapping to the nearest available root.
description.interpretation_notes: The selector names a configurable family composition, so serialized nonzero axes identify enabled recurrence terms but do not by themselves prove which term is visually dominant in a captured frame.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Y is the live engine selector for engineered multi-warp Newton composite.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: per-iteration re-warped Newton step on P, blended back into z with fixed mix, velocity carry, pixel-attractor pull, and soft radial clamp.
description.state_order: second-order in (z_n,z_{n-1}) because velocity uses z_n-z_{n-1}.
description.termination_or_classification: tracks best residual, accepts direct convergence at |P|<epsilon, otherwise snaps best point to nearest root for basin assignment.
description.interpretation_notes: At high zoom, a small dynamics-parameter change can move or reorganize visible structures substantially; compare against the exact viewport facts rather than inferring visual scale from numeric magnitude.

description.termination_or_classification: direct convergence at |P|<epsilon; if not converged by the limit, snap to nearest known root and still emit a basin classification.

description.math_summary: Counterfactual Pair compares two Newton orbits initialized at a sampled coordinate and a configured world-absolute or view-relative offset.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: Each member independently applies Newton's method to the selected cubic or quartic polynomial while the engine accumulates their mean separation.
description.state_order: Each orbit is first-order in its own z state; the pair classifier additionally retains cross-orbit separation statistics.
description.termination_or_classification: The pair is classified as reconverged at one root, same-root drift, different-root basin swap, or unresolved according to both orbit terminations, nearest roots, and the configured reconvergence ratio.
description.interpretation_notes: The output is a synthetic pair class and mean-gap signal; it is not direct evidence that two distinct visible structures occupy the same image location.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Counterfactual Pair compares two damped Newton orbits initialized from an ExplainO-warped sample and a configured world-absolute or view-relative offset.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: Each member independently applies damped Newton iteration to the current ExplainO polynomial; nearest-root classification uses explicit ExplainO roots when present and otherwise the polynomial's unit-root family.
description.state_order: Each orbit is first-order in its own z state; the pair classifier additionally retains cross-orbit separation statistics.
description.termination_or_classification: The pair is classified as reconverged at one root, same-root drift, different-root basin swap, or unresolved according to both orbit terminations, nearest roots, and the configured reconvergence ratio.
description.interpretation_notes: The initial warp and pair offset can both move the comparison at high zoom; the synthetic class does not spatially localize either orbit beyond the sampled coordinate.

description.math_summary: Projection and Flow applies Newton motion followed by radial projection onto a configured circle and classifies root identity together with transient projection pressure.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: After each unconstrained Newton step, a nonconverged finite state is projected to the target radius; the engine records projection pressure as the radial correction magnitude.
description.state_order: The projected orbit is first-order in z, with accumulated peak and last projection pressure retained for final classification.
description.termination_or_classification: A state can converge before or after the free Newton step, stop on a degenerate derivative or nonfinite state, or reach the iteration limit; the final class combines nearest root with one of four transient-pressure bands plus an unresolved class.
description.interpretation_notes: Pressure bands summarize the difference between peak and final projection pressure and do not identify a spatial force field outside this sampled recurrence.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Projection and Flow applies adaptive damped Newton motion from an ExplainO-warped sample, then radially projects nonconverged states onto a configured circle.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The free step uses the current ExplainO polynomial and damping divided by one plus Newton-step magnitude; finite nonconverged states are then projected to the target radius.
description.state_order: The projected orbit is first-order in z, with accumulated peak and last projection pressure retained for final classification.
description.termination_or_classification: A state can converge before or after the free step, stop on a degenerate derivative or nonfinite state, or reach the iteration limit; the final class combines nearest root with transient-pressure band.
description.interpretation_notes: The initial warp, damping, target radius, and pressure threshold can all reorganize high-zoom structure; the pressure class does not by itself spatially localize a cause.

description.math_summary: Magnet Type I is the live engine selector for bounded 2D rational escape-time Magnet Type I.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The pixel coordinate is c and the configured Magnet seed initializes z; the squared rational update ((z squared - 1 + c) / (2z - 2 + c)) squared is blended from the prior z by relaxation clamped to 0.05 through 1.5.
description.state_order: For fixed c, seed, and relaxation, the Magnet recurrence is first-order in z.
description.termination_or_classification: Iteration converges when squared distance from z to the unit attractor is below epsilon squared, or otherwise stops at the configured Magnet bailout, a nonfinite state, or the iteration limit.
description.interpretation_notes: At high zoom, a small dynamics-parameter change can move or reorganize visible structures substantially; compare against the exact viewport facts rather than inferring visual scale from numeric magnitude.

description.math_summary: Generic Equation Pack is a programmable engine lane whose active recurrence is supplied by the validated loaded equation-pack descriptor rather than one fixed built-in formula.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The runtime lowers the selected pack operations into the generic complex sample core; the concrete recurrence and constants therefore come from the attached pack authority.
description.state_order: State order is pack-defined and must be read from the active pack operations rather than inferred from this selector name.
description.termination_or_classification: Escape, convergence, and classification follow the validated pack program and the generic runtime limits.
description.interpretation_notes: Do not attribute a particular formula to this selector without the exact loaded pack; the catalog describes the programmable substrate only.

description.math_summary: SDF Pack Scene is a field-primary lane that evaluates a validated authored or built-in signed-distance scene instead of iterating a complex orbit.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The field producer evaluates the selected SDF pack graph at the sampled coordinate; there is no universal complex recurrence for this selector.
description.state_order: Evaluation is descriptor-driven and field-primary rather than an orbit with a fixed recurrence order.
description.termination_or_classification: Classification and coloring consume the signed-distance field and its declared scene semantics rather than escape-time iteration.
description.interpretation_notes: Geometric claims require the exact attached SDF pack; selector identity alone does not specify the scene primitives or composition.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Root SDF is a field-primary lane derived from the current ExplainO root layout.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The engine lowers effective roots to root circles and bridge capsules with optional deterministic phase-sine modulation, producing a signed-distance field rather than an orbit recurrence.
description.state_order: It evaluates a root-derived field at each coordinate and has no iterative orbit state order.
description.termination_or_classification: The result is classified through signed-distance field membership; unsupported non-SDF source rows fail closed.
description.interpretation_notes: Serialized root geometry supplies field inputs, but root symmetry alone does not prove visible frame symmetry after camera and coloring transformations.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Mandelbrot Root Trap uses Mandelbrot orbit dynamics and exposes the current ExplainO root field only to downstream trap coloring.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The base orbit is z_next = z squared + c from z_0 = 0; root-field data does not feed back into that recurrence.
description.state_order: The orbit is first-order in z for fixed pixel parameter c.
description.termination_or_classification: It uses Mandelbrot escape/interior classification at radius two, nonfinite state, or the iteration limit.
description.interpretation_notes: Root proximity is a continuous coloring signal and does not by itself establish discrete root basins or causal visual dominance.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Magnet Root Well is a root-field coloring consumer whose orbit dynamics use the engine's Magnet Type-I base recurrence.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: For each pixel the coordinate is the recurrence parameter c and the configured Magnet seed is the initial z. The squared rational update ((z^2 - 1 + c) / (2z - 2 + c))^2 is blended from the prior z by relaxation clamped to the interval 0.05 through 1.5.
description.state_order: The Magnet update is first-order in z for fixed pixel coordinate, seed, and relaxation; root-pattern data is consumed later by coloring rather than fed back into the base recurrence.
description.termination_or_classification: Iteration converges when the squared distance from z to the unit attractor falls below epsilon squared, and otherwise stops on the configured Magnet bailout, a nonfinite state, or the iteration limit.
description.interpretation_notes: Root-field distance and nearest-root signals can shape coloring around configured, generated, or fallback unit roots. Those coloring signals are downstream of the Magnet recurrence, and continuous proximity alone does not establish discrete basins.

description.math_summary: ExplainO Multibrot Root Trap uses Multibrot orbit dynamics and exposes the current ExplainO root field only to downstream trap coloring.
description.recurrence_or_field_model: The base orbit uses the configured principal complex power in z_next = z to power p plus c; root-field data does not feed back into that recurrence.
description.state_order: The orbit is first-order in z for fixed c and power.
description.termination_or_classification: It uses direct escape/interior classification at radius two, nonfinite state, or the iteration limit.
description.interpretation_notes: Power changes can reorganize orbit geometry sharply, while root proximity remains a downstream coloring signal rather than proof of basins.
